forward_looking_note: Written for the unstable dialect, to see what a rule that moves on more than one time axis looks like once the multitemporal built-ins reach main. A main build (1.6.98) cannot read the modules that use them. NOT the answer of record: the stable encoding of the same facts is encodings/legalese-sonnet-5.5/.

scope: s 2(1) 'broadcasting service' and 'broadcasting apparatus'; s 20(1)(a)-(c); s 47; the First Schedule in both texts; S 549/2012 cl 1-2. Everything else in the Broadcasting Act is out of scope, including s 20(3), s 20(4) and the Exemption Orders (which the stable row has).
not_reviewed: No domain expert has read this against the source. Whether a Notification is effective before its first publication, and whether a retrospective commencement under s 65 reaches conduct, are not in the sources and are not asserted. The 5.00 pm of first publication is not representable and a reader on 31 October 2012 is counted as reading after it, by convention. The independent test pass of the encoding-a-subject skill was not done. The stable row was read at 23:46 on 2026-11-03, when it had no version table for the First Schedule, and its nouns file re-read at 23:56, when it declared one; no rule module of it reads that table yet.
findings: NOTES.md, section 'Findings on the semantics'; reproducers and their output in findings/.
target_reason: written for the unstable dialect on purpose: it uses the time built-ins RULES EFFECTIVE DATE, EVAL UNDER VALID TIME, EVAL AS OF SYSTEM TIME and EVAL UNDER RULES EFFECTIVE AT (removed from main in build 98), and REFUSE and #ASSERT REFUSED, none of which the main compiler reads. check.sh is run as L4_TARGET=unstable and so makes no main comparison; each module was run once on the main build instead.
deployable_reason: Legalese Cloud runs the stable build, which rejects the time built-ins and REFUSE (it prints 'could not find a definition' for each; findings/main-build-per-module.out), so none of the modules that use them can be deployed there.
unstable_only_statement: UNSTABLE-ONLY, FORWARD-LOOKING, DO NOT DEPLOY. Not the answer of record: the stable encoding of the same facts is encodings/legalese-sonnet-5.5/.
